mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_report (user_id, week_year, week_num, start_date, end_date, week_summary, problem_review, next_week_plan, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{weekYear}, #{weekNum}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{weekSummary}, #{problemReview}, #{nextWeekPlan}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_report SET week_year = #{weekYear}, week_num = #{weekNum}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, week_summary = #{weekSummary}, problem_review = #{problemReview}, next_week_plan = #{nextWeekPlan}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM weekly_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (week_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR problem_review LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR next_week_plan LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY week_year DESC, week_num DESC
